title: Doubles: Add the Same Number Twice

scenes.title: Doubles: Add the Same Number Twice
scenes.subtitle: A super fun math trick!

beats.say: Assalamu alaikum, my little math stars! I'm Ollie the Owl.
Today we learn a super fun trick called doubles!

points.text: Add a number to the same number

beats.say: A double is when we add a number to the very same number.
Look! We have two eyes. One plus one equals two.
Same number, two times. That's a double!
Here are four red apples and four green apples.
Two.
Four.
Six.
Eight!
Four plus four equals eight!
Let's try seven plus seven with our cubes.
Seven plus seven equals fourteen!
Quiz time! What is six plus six?
Twelve! Six plus six equals twelve. Great job!
Now, what is nine plus nine?
Eighteen!
Three orange fish and three striped fish. Three plus three is six.
Then add one more fish.
Six plus one equals seven!
Let's sort them. Is it a double or not?
Five plus five and two plus two are doubles.
Four plus three and seven plus one are not doubles.
Meg puts eight apples in a basket.
Paul puts in eight apples too.
Eight plus eight equals sixteen apples!

scenes.heading: Did you know?
scenes.text: A spider has 4 legs on each side. 4 + 4 = 8 legs!

beats.say: Did you know? A spider has four legs on each side. Four plus four makes eight legs!

scenes.heading: From the Seerah
scenes.translation: In Madinah, the Prophet paired the Muhajirun and the Ansar as brothers, two by two, so everyone had a partner to share with.

beats.say: In Madinah, the Prophet, peace be upon him, made people brothers in pairs, two by two, so they could share and help each other.

points.text: A double = same number two times
Doubles plus one helps us add

beats.say: A double is the same number two times.
Doubles answers jump up by two.
And doubles plus one helps us add other numbers!

scenes.title: Great job, math stars!
scenes.subtitle: See you in the next lesson

beats.say: Great job, math stars! Please like and subscribe. Allah Hafiz!
